pages.text: Stranded as a jar? Press $(l)Courier$() in the jar menu, or type /headoffice courier. In 30 s your body, or its corpse, arrives beside you from anywhere, for 20 kFE (or all your charge). Step into a body with $(k:key.headinajar.swap); a corpse takes a Suture Kit.
A jar module: while you are a jar, your standing body walks to you, 10 FE/t. Same dimension and loaded chunks only. It halts before lava, fire or a drop of over 3 blocks.
